entities.name: Mohammed bin Nawwaf bin Abdulaziz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohammed bin Nawwaf Al Saud is a Saudi Arabian diplomat who served as the Saudi Arabian ambassador to Italy, Malta, the United Kingdom, and Ireland. He is a member of the Saudi ruling family, a grandson of King Abdulaziz.
